title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Bethel Woods Center for the Arts, Bethel | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Bethel Woods Center for the Arts, Bethel, New York, USA, on 25 September 2026.

It was the second show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s fall tour of the USA, which lasted for nine dates in September and October 2026.

Starr had previously performed at the Bethel Woods Center for the Arts on 26 June 2010, 16 June 2012, and 16 August 2019.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
